A couple notes:  -when I color, it’s a lot of trial and error so I apologize if the steps are a little confusing  -wait for acrylic to be mostly dry before using markers over them -beware: using alcohol markers over acrylic to blend may ruin your nibs but ohuhu sells replacements  -I ended up using a white gel pen on the edges (not shown)  Materials  @Ohuhuart alcohol markers  @Prismacolor colored pencil in espresso  @Languo Stationery acrylic markers @colorwithkathy scribble pad pro  #coloringbook #coloring #cocowyo #coloringtutorial #colorwithme
